new_written_lemma_U.statement: WRITTEN. Upward-closure lemma. In any FACT solution, for every delta in A-A and every integer t prime to |A|, gcd(t*delta,n) does not lie in Div(B). The same holds with A and B swapped. Proof: by I1, tA+B=Z_n, and Div(tA) contains gcd(t*delta,n). By I2, Div(tA) and Div(B) meet only in {n}.
new_written_lemma_U.consequence_example: If 7 does not divide |A|, then Div(A) does not contain 2. The B0 difference 14 puts gcd(14,n) in Div(B). When 7 does not divide n this equals 2. When 7 divides n, any delta with gcd(delta,n)=2 gives gcd(7*delta,n)=14 for t=7.
new_written_lemma_U.scope: A necessary filter, used below. It is not a contradiction.

size_six_cascade.statement: WRITTEN. Exact classification of the cyclotomic data of a FACT side with |A|=6.
size_six_cascade.proof: A tiles Z, so Coven-Meyerowitz T1 (a named import) gives S_A = one power of 2 plus one power of 3. For a prime power p^k, A(zeta_{p^k})=0 iff the counts of A mod p^k are constant on each coset of the order-p subgroup. Applying this to A containing {0,3,8,11} plus two further elements x,y:
size_six_cascade.power_of_2: 2^i with i in {1,4}. i=2 and i=3 need at least 8 elements. i>=5 cannot pair 0,3,8,11 among themselves. i=1 means x,y have opposite parity. i=4 means x-y = 8 mod 16.
size_six_cascade.power_of_3: 3^j with j in {1,2}. j=1 means x = y = 1 mod 3. j=2 means {x,y} = {5,6} mod 9. j>=3 needs 12 elements.
size_six_cascade.T2: CM Theorem B2 (named import; two prime factors) adds Phi_{2^i 3^j} | A. In case (1,1), A is a complete residue system mod 6.
size_six_cascade.other_constraints: No unit differences (since 1 is in Div(B)), lemma U, and n = 0 mod lcm(6*330, 8) = 3960.
size_six_cascade.outcome: All four cases survive these written filters. The explicit example A={0,3,8,11,85,256} (case (1,1), checkpoint-05) has no unit differences and tiles with 6Z. Whether a complement containing B0 exists is OPEN. NO contradiction; recorded so the search space is exact.
